# Project instructions

## Project
Read `docs/requirements.md` and `docs/05-implementation-plan.md` before working.
Follow the front-desk, library, search, and game-details requirements.

## Data and safety
Use the datasets in `00/` as read-only source data.
Do not modify the original files in `00/`.
Do not expose secrets or use destructive commands.

## Workflow
Work on one GitHub Issue at a time.
Read the issue’s acceptance criteria before making changes.
Make a short plan before implementing a feature.
Report what was tested and do not claim success without verification.

## Project-specific rules
- The website should start at the front desk.
- The Explore action should open the library page.
- The Search action should open a matching game or a clear game-not-found page.
- Show `Not Available` for missing game fields and `No image available` for missing images.
- Keep layouts usable on desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
